name: Uplift AI
tagline: Foundational Voice AI for underserved languages
long_description:
We build speech understanding and speech generation models for the five major languages spoken in Pakistan, where 42% of the adult population can not read any language. 

Pakistan is the 5th most populous country in the world with a $411 billion GDP. Yet its overlooked and no practical voice models exist for the local languages.

With our APIs and SDKs, businesses offer high-quality voice interfaces in domains like banking, agriculture, healthcare, and government services. This enables them to finally offer digital services to every customer -- often for the first time.

Our founding team has a decade of experience building world-leading voice products, including at Alexa and Siri. We have launched entire AWS services; and software written by us previously is used by millions daily.

We do in-house research and development. We gather our own data, then train and deploy our own models. We own our technology stack end-to-end.

We are on a mission to uplift entire nations through better access to digital information and digital services.
founders: Muhammad Bin Sabir, Hammad Malik, Zaid Qureshi

name: Paloma
tagline: Modular quoting and billing platform configured using natural language
long_description:
Paloma is a modular quote-to-cash stack that lets you manage pricing, quoting, and billing processes using natural language.

B2B quoting and billing systems are stuck in the past. Rigid configurations and overly templatized rules slow down businesses, lead to erroneous manual processes , and result in fragmented sources of truths. Paloma lets you define your business rules in natural language, integrate your playbooks into the sales and quoting process, and automate bespoke billing processes for each of your contracts.
founders: Alex Avnit, Nazli Danis, Kaiwen Song

name: Mobile Operator
tagline: AI agent that does QA on mobile apps
long_description: Stop manually testing your app. Simply connect Mobile Operator to your CI/CD and let our AI agents take over. They explore your app like real users, not only catching crashes and bugs but also spotting UX problems.

name: Nox Metals
tagline: The modern factory for fast, low-cost metals.
long_description: Nox Metals is building the fastest metals processing factories in North America. Our software runs quoting, scheduling, and operations to streamline production and reduce cost. We supply America's industrial base with custom-cut material at unmatched speed and efficiency.

name: Freya
tagline: Voice AI Agents For Financial Services And Other Regulated Industries

name: Luminal
tagline: Simple ML framework and cloud for generating fast GPU code.
long_description:
Luminal builds an ML framework and compiler that generates GPU code.
Our stack 10x's model speed while simplifying deployment and cutting idle GPU costs

Github: https://github.com/jafioti/luminal
Discord: https://discord.gg/2Mxur3CgYT
founders: Joe Fioti, Matthew Gunton, Jake Stevens

name: RealRoots
tagline: RealRoots is a mobile app that guarantees women lifelong friendships.
long_description: RealRoots is a mobile app that guarantees women lifelong friendships. After a quick 10-minute survey, we match each user with compatible friends nearby. From there, our AI assistant plans thoughtful, recurring hangs - so her social calendar stays full of meaningful connection.

name: Veritus Agent
tagline: AI agents for loan servicing and collections
long_description:
Veritus is a platform for deploying AI agents for loan servicing and collections, including inbound and outbound voice agents. Our agents negotiate repayment plans, follow up across channels, and drive recoveries with zero human involvement.

We license our platform to lenders and collections agencies, and we're also in the process of getting licensed in all 50 states to enable our own third-party collections and debt buying. By combining cutting edge voice AI with deep regulatory compliance and vertical specialization we're able to drastically reduce the cost-to-collect while increasing recovery rates.
founders: Joshua March, David Schlesinger, Joseph Stein

name: Blue
tagline: The first voice assistant that can control every app on your phone.
long_description:
Blue is the first voice assistant that can control every app on your phone.

Most assistants today, such as Siri, Alexa, or Gemini, are limited to narrow functions like setting timers or answering questions. They cannot message your friends on Messenger, send money on Venmo, or compare ride-share prices to book the best option.

Blue can do all of this and more.

It taps, swipes, and types like a human on both Android and iPhone, so it doesn't need any app-specific integrations. This is made possible through a voice-first computer-use model as well as a custom hardware. 

It already works in the real world. Users are texting, shopping, and navigating their phones completely hands-free. People who are commuting, cooking, or multitasking are using Blue to reclaim meaningful time during their day.

Our team brings rare and highly complementary experience. Omar led Google Assistant’s transition to LLMs and holds one of the earliest patents in LLM-based computer control. Peter brings decades of experience designing and building voice-first dialog systems, holds multiple design patents, and was most recently the design lead at Google DeepMind serving actions on the Gemini Live model. Farhan helped ship Apple’s Vision Pro and holds more than 50 patents in hardware and systems design. He's also led several products end-to-end from early prototyping to mass production and global fulfillment.

Together, we have built systems used by billions of people and are now building something even more fundamental: re-inventing the way we use and interact with technology.
founders: Omar Abdelaziz, Farhan Hossain, Peter Krogh

name: Interfere
tagline: The self-healing layer of the internet

name: Outrove
tagline: AI-native Salesforce
long_description:
We’re building the next-generation sales and marketing automation platform, designed for how B2B go-to-market will work in the AI era.

As channels and content formats shift dramatically, we’ll be the OS companies rely on to power their future GTM strategies.

name: NOSO LABS
tagline: Build AI agents for field technicians to diagnose and sell 10x better
long_description: In the home services industry, field technicians are expected to handle three key tasks: diagnosing issues, making sales, and completing paperwork. It's rare to find individuals who excel at all three. We build AI agents to support technicians by improving diagnostic accuracy and helping them capture sales opportunities.

name: Vulcan Technologies
tagline: AI regulatory drafting and compliance
long_description:
Vulcan uses AI to map every law, regulation, and court case in America, allowing government agencies and businesses to replace massive consulting projects with instant automated analyses. We call this "intelligent legal cartography."

In 3 months, we went from zero customers to Virginia's Executive Order 51, requiring all state agencies to use Vulcan. We are now live with the U.S. Department of Education, a regulatory reform PAC in South Carolina, and have a pipeline of several additional state and federal agencies and major enterprises.

Our initial agency partners use legal cartography to draft lawful regulations, respond to public comments on regulations, and instantly generate mandatory cost-benefit analyses.

We have both public and private sector visions. In the private sector: we endeavor to automate the entire regulatory process end-to-end; replacing the consulting industrial complex with software. In the private sector: we plan to automate regulatory compliance, tackling the $4 trillion regulatory cost on the U.S. economy.
founders: Tanner Jones, Aleksander Mekhanik, Chris Minge

name: TectoAI
tagline: Governance for AI Employees
long_description: We help your company identify roles that can be filled by agentic AI tools, onboard them quickly, monitor their performance and behavior post deployement, ensure they remain compliant, and aligned with regulations. Tecto is building the HR system for managing your AI employees!

name: Anytrace
tagline: The AI support engineering agent
long_description:
Anytrace is the first AI agent that automates the end-to-end workflow of a support engineer. Our agent resolves technical support tickets by interacting with customers, investigating root causes, and tracking issues to completion.

Sam (CEO) was previously the co-founder and CEO of a DevOps platform that raised $2M. Taira (CTO) was the youngest SDE 2 at AWS Sagemaker Inference. We have over five years of experience handling technical support for customers ranging from small startups to Fortune 500 companies like Salesforce.

We came into YC with just an idea, and we already have our first pilot customer paying $5 per support ticket.

Essentially every B2B software company devotes engineering time to support, and our goal is to automate this away.

name: Perspectives Health
tagline: Automating EMRs for frontline clinicians
founders: Eshan Dosani, Kyle Hyun Woo Jung, Nicholas Kovalsky, Jesse Tabak

name: Modelence
tagline: All-in-one TypeScript platform for startups
long_description:
You built the demo in a weekend. Now you need auth, a prod-grade database, real-time events, AI observability, cron jobs, email, monitoring… and you needed them yesterday.

We spent a decade at our previous startup, building a platform while scaling to millions of users and customers like Meta & Netflix. Now we put that into an open-source framework, so others wouldn’t have to do the same from scratch.

Modelence is a batteries-included framework that abstracts away boilerplate so you can just focus on building your product logic and nothing else - it’s like Next.js + Vercel + Supabase on a single platform, built for full-stack TypeScript.

Shipping production apps is much harder than building a prototype that runs locally and 95% of all production apps share the same building blocks. We did a massive amount of work on our previous platforms that was not specific to our product, and we’ve created Modelence to abstract that away:
- Authentication
- Database setup
- Hosting / CDN
- AI integration (LLM observability, prompts)
- Real-time events
- Cron jobs
- Email service
- Monitoring
- Analytics
- Admin dashboards

Andrej Karpathy recently posted about this same exact problem:
https://x.com/karpathy/status/1905051558783418370

and explained it further in his YC AI Startup School talk:
https://youtu.be/LCEmiRjPEtQ?feature=shared&t=1940

name: Magnetic
tagline: AI tax preparation for CPAs
long_description:
Magnetic scans client documents - from handwritten charity notes to excel spreadsheet Schedule Cs to multi-state K-1s - and enters them into tax software automatically, saving hours of tedious data entry. 

The accounting profession is facing a massive talent shortage, as graduates choose different professions and the old guard begins to retire. As a result, CPA and tax preparation firms are awash in clientele, but unable to keep up. At many firms, phones go unanswered, clients are "fired", and websites are taken down, as the existing workforce tries to handle the grueling 80 hour+ weeks necessary to push through tax season to the April 15th deadline.

We built this because a former colleague who owns her own tax firm asked us to automate her workload, and we quickly realized the massive opportunity. Thomas brings deep domain expertise as the former Head of Product at Keeper (YC W19), where he built tax engine automation systems and an OCR form scanning system that outperformed everything else on the market. At Keeper, he leveraged early access to OpenAI's LLMs (well before ChatGPT) to build systems that automated the entire tax filing process, allowing a tiny team of CPAs to process thousands of returns with near zero busy work. Patrick was the first engineer at FunCraft, shipping multiple mobile games with 1M+ downloads and building scalable shared codebases. We've worked together since 2017, including co-leading multiple teams at Zynga as PM & Tech Lead respectively.

We launched this year in the middle of tax season and quickly processed hundreds of returns, earning thousands in ARR, and since tax season we've been growing customers by >30% month-over-month. We've completely automated over 25% of the return process so far and developed a proprietary vision model that beats incumbent scanning technology by almost 2x on accuracy - jumping from 50% field-level accuracy to 89%, approaching the quality of their expensive human-verified service at 92%.

The opportunity is massive - there are 80M US personal tax returns filed via professionals annually, in a $2B outsourcing market where individual CPA firms currently pay $100k-$1M per year for inferior services. We're positioned to capture significant market share by offering better accuracy & document coverage, instant processing, and superior user experience.

We've built this kind of software before, we've worked together for years (and even lived together), we've built products to $10M ARR before, and we have the grit to outwork anyone in this space.

name: Flywheel AI
tagline: Waymo for excavators
long_description: Flywheel AI converts any existing excavators for contractors to enable remote ops to increase safety and productivity, and use robotics context dataset to train autonomous policies.

name: Fleetline
tagline: Optimizing fleet planning with data driven algorithms
long_description: Fleetline is building the first complete-context algorithmic load planner for mid to large-sized trucking fleets. Today’s dispatchers face an overwhelming task: balancing regulations, customer demands, live fleet data, and individual driver needs, all while coordinating across siloed tools and teams. Mistakes run rampant, and each mistake is thousands of dollars. Even the select fleets using algorithms that have fleet-wide context struggle: the outputs are rigid, hard to interpret, and are blind to real-world nuances like driver preferences and schedule exceptions. Fleetline solves this by combining advanced optimization with LLMs that can easily adapt algorithms to each fleet’s needs and capture driver-specific information. The result is smarter planning truly optimized for every fleet and its drivers.

name: Clodo
tagline: The AI Assistant for Real Estate Agents
long_description:
Clodo is the AI Assistant for Real Estate Agents. 

Clodo helps agents remember and follow up with all their leads. Building up your database and following up with leads are the two most valuable actions you can perform as a real estate agent. Currently, both of these tasks involve spending hours sifting through dashboards and spreadsheets, and a lot of guesswork.

With Clodo, we see agents effortlessly performing both those tasks and turning their database into a stronger engine for business.
founders: Rithvik Chuppala, Sid Rajaram, Arnav Verma

name: stagewise
tagline: The frontend coding agent for production codebases
long_description:
stagewise is the first frontend coding agent for existing production-grade web apps. It lives right inside your browser, makes changes in your local codebase and is compatible with all kinds of frameworks and setups - allowing it to be retrofitted into any existing project.

Our agent enables you to show and tell what you want to change - all while using your app on localhost and without having to switch to external tools. Making changes is as easy as selecting elements, giving a simple prompt like “make it green and put it in the top right corner”, and immediately seeing the result.

We're two founders from Germany who met while working at a B2B SaaS startup. With backgrounds in both enterprise engineering (Rheinmetall, dSPACE) and building web apps used by thousands, we have the unique blend of discipline and product sense needed to build this.

After making our initial launch with the open-sourced toolbar that puts your favorite coding agent right inside your browser and going viral with it, we’re now launching a high-speed coding agent dedicated to frontend development - taking our product and the experience of our users to the next level.

Our vision is to empower anyone to create well-designed applications, regardless of their technical skill. We start with developers who lack design experience, but our ultimate goal is to change how products are built. stagewise will enable non-technical stakeholders - product managers, designers, and marketers - to directly iterate on the UI themselves, creating a new, collaborative workflow and making us the essential tool for building on the web.

name: burnt
tagline: Agentic Operating System for Food Supply Chain
long_description:
Food Supply Chain companies have been using legacy ERPs for decades. Everyone knows these are necessary evils that essentially run the business but take up a lot of operational capacity. They are not about to just rip and replace their existing system that runs their whole business with a system that takes years to implement. Imagine if they could implement AI that runs the ERP for them, in weeks?

Burnt’s building an agentic OS for the Food Supply Chain with AI Agents for each department. 

Our AI Agent, Ozai, has started by replacing the whole order management job function at food distribution companies, so that sales and customer service teams can focus on what matters - the customer. Ozai monitors all incoming messages (emails, phone calls, voicemails, whatsapp, fax etc.), figures out if it's an order, learns each customer's habits, shorthand, and favorite products, picks up on any prep notes, and enters it straight into the existing ERP. It'll even go back to the customers on your behalf when it's not sure about something, clarify things and carry on working. 

The more it sees, the smarter it gets.
founders: Joseph Jacob, Rhea Karimpanal, Chandru Shanumugasundaram

name: Okibi
tagline: Build agents using natural language, it's Lovable for agents
long_description:
Whether you're building an internal workflow automation to remove repetitive or time consuming tasks, or launching your own product with Agents, Okibi can help you build it.

Building AI agents typically requires complex, time-consuming setup, including tool calling, LLM syntax management, multi-agent orchestration, browser use, evals, and hosting deployments.

Our web app provides a chat interface and toolkit to easily create agents. Just describe your agent in natural language, similar to vibecoding, and our app automatically generates your agent's architecture, tool calls, human in the loop, browser user, and runs evals on your agent.

This approach significantly reduces development complexity and time.

name: Kernel
tagline: High performance browsers-as-a-service for web agents & automations
long_description:
Kernel is the best place in the world to launch web agents and browser automations. We handle the hard parts of running browser infrastructure in the cloud so you don’t have to: spinning up browsers quickly, responsive read/write live view, logs, headless vs. headful mode, replays, residential proxies, and more. Our API allows developers to instantly launch browsers in the cloud, so you can focus on your core product logic rather than the infra underneath.

Our customers use Kernel to launch QA agents, vertical-specific agents that automate back office processes, and more.

We're open source, HIPAA-compliant (SOC2 Type 2 pending), & compatible with every browser/web agent framework (Playwright, Puppeteer, CUA, Browser Use, Magnitude, etc). Check us out —> https://github.com/onkernel/kernel-images

name: dScribe AI
tagline: Track bulk inventory with autonomous drones and 3D vision
long_description:
dScribe AI uses autonomous drones and 3D vision to track bulk inventory. We're starting by helping the ag and mining industry track stockpiles of grain and gravel.

Bulk inventory tracking is broken. Companies either rely on guesstimates or pay for expensive manual surveys which are still off by 20 to 30%. Without accurate numbers, it’s hard to plan logistics, like how many truckloads are needed. And it creates accounting issues by misreporting inventory value, hurting financial planning and leading to missed opportunities.

We’ve lived this problem, and we know how to solve it. Warren saw it firsthand as a Product Manager at Milk Moovement, a $20M Series A AgTech startup, working closely with feed suppliers and farm managers. Jordan scaled Microsoft Azure’s largest public API, handling over 700M requests/month, and sold software to a public company. Cole was engineer #3 at Tropic, scaling it from seed to Series B, and later led engineering at an AI startup.

We’ve built an integrated hardware and software platform that’s now being piloted by some of the largest agriculture and construction companies in North America. As industries demand real-time visibility into the physical world, dScribe AI is positioned to become the system of record for inventory that don’t fit in traditional boxes and barcodes.
founders: Jordan Mryyan, Cole Robertson, Warren Wijaya Wang

name: Daymi
tagline: Text your personal AI clone
long_description:
Daymi is an AI clone of the user that they can text or call. Daymi's familiar voice makes it easy for users to share their thoughts, explore new ideas, and just have fun. 

ChatGPT is boring. AI girlfriends are harmful. Daymi is a new take on a personal AI companion that is both entertaining and productive.
founders: Aldrin Ong, Noah Yin, Jeffrey Yum

name: Reacher
tagline: We help brands scale creator partnerships 10x faster
long_description:
Reacher automates affiliate marketing for enterprise brands, replacing teams of 5+ people with AI-powered creator discovery, outreach, and management. 

Trusted by brands driving $20M+ in GMV, we're building the largest marketplace where creators access premium deals guided by an AI talent manager, while brands access our vetted network of top creators.

name: Nottelabs
tagline: Building infrastructure for reliable web agents
long_description: Nottelabs designs browsers using agents for enterprise. Focused on reliability and scalability, we convert websites into structured text APIs to power LLM-driven web scraping and workflow automation, with full support for stealth, vaults, and enterprise tooling.

name: Certus AI
tagline: Replacing the restaurant phone line with Voice AI
long_description:
Certus AI is replacing the restaurant phone line with Voice AI.

Restaurants lose up to $100,000 per year per location from missed calls, lost orders, and abandoned hold lines. Staff are overwhelmed. IVRs frustrate customers. Call centers are expensive and impersonal.

It’s 2025. Guests don’t leave voicemails or wait on hold. They just move on.

Certus is an AI voice agent built for restaurants. It answers every call, 24/7 — taking orders, processing deliveries, booking reservations, upselling, and handling complaints in English, Spanish, French and more. Certus is built to manage the phone line end to end, from the customer call to the restaurant tech stack, with zero human intervention required. It currently integrates with industry-leading systems like Toast, Square, Clover, UberEats, DoorDash, and more.

We’re building the voice layer of the modern restaurant — the employee they’ll never fire.

We started Certus because we lived the pain. Gurveer (CEO) grew up answering phones in his family’s restaurant and helped operate them, growing from 1 to 11 locations in 7 years. Later, he and Adam (CRO) ran a restaurant growth startup to help others increase revenue, but kept watching clients bleed cash because no one picked up the phone. So we built the solution the industry always wished existed.

Until now, this problem was considered unsolvable. But Voice AI has finally crossed the conversational chasm and 72% of consumers now prefer AI over humans as long as it means faster and better service.

More importantly, the market is begging for this. The North American restaurant industry crossed $1 trillion in 2024, and it's projected to hit $1.5 trillion in 2025. Yet over $100 billion is still lost annually to missed calls, human error, and outdated tech. As the market continues to grow, so do the losses!

Our customers say it best:

- “Certus changed my life overnight.”
- “We were losing the ability to give great in-house service — the phone was killing us.”
-  “70% of my business comes through the phone. That’s mine and my 16 staffs livelihood.”
- “Before Certus, I used to lose 40 - 60 calls a day…. now my printer just stays printing!”
-  “I’ve been in the business 38 years. I’ve been waiting for this since then.”

Certus is here to fix the $120B phone problem — one call at a time.

And in doing so, we’re redefining how the restaurant industry communicates forever, starting with the phone line.
founders: Adam Gamieldien, Isaac Nichols, Gurveer Singh

name: Hera
tagline: AI Motion Designer
long_description:
Hera is an AI motion designer that turns 5-hour projects into 5-minute tasks. 

When you're a YouTuber making an infographic animation, instead of spending hours manually clicking buttons in Adobe After Effects, you can create the same animation in minutes in Hera. 

Through talking to our users, we realized that 95% of time spent on motion graphics is manual button clicking, not creative work. This insight led us to focus on automating the tedious parts while giving the user all creative control.

We launched in May 2025, got 100k waitlist signups in 8 weeks, and we're doubling revenue monthly.

name: Pally
tagline: Pally is an AI Relationship Management Platform
long_description:
Hey 👋, we’re Haz and Wyatt, the founders of Pally, and we’re building at the intersection of AI and Human Relationships. 

We believe that while AI will automate a lot of low-level tasks, that this will dramatically increase the value of human connection at the highest level.

In a world full of ‘AI SDRs’, our warm connections become more important than ever. 

Yet today, keeping track of thousands of connections across countless social platforms is impossible. We forget to respond, we miss important moments, we lose touch.  

We’re building Pally to solve that. 

We bring together every connection, across every platform. Our AI researches everything they’ve ever posted online, and uses its deep understanding of each person to help you achieve your goals; whether hiring, fundraising, or sales.

name: Convexia
tagline: The world's first AI-maximalist pharma company
long_description:
An AI-maximalist pharma platform. We use agents to buy drugs, run clinical trials, and sell for a profit. 10x faster and 20x leaner than incumbents.

Sourcing Agent: Mines public/private databases and unstructured global data to surface overlooked preclinical candidates.
Scientific Agent: Runs comp bio models (ESM-3, RFdiffusion, MACE-MP-0) to assess safety and efficacy in silico.
Commercial Agent: Analyzes FDA incentives, pricing dynamics, TAM, competitive landscape, and payer alignment.
Clinical Agent: Runs digital twin simulations, evaluates CRO/CMC risk, and builds trial plans to Phase 1.
BD Agent: Summarizes and delivers company-tailored pitches. 

Built by 2 Stanford CS students who have built 3 startups together before.

name: Locata
tagline: AI referral management for Health Centers
long_description:
Locata is an AI referral management platform for Health Centers. We deploy AI agents to automate every step of the referral process that back-office staff face daily, from submitting authorizations to broadcasting updates and following up with patients. This frees up staff to focus on patient care.

Primary Care back-offices are severely understaffed and overburdened by administrative work associated with referrals. Additionally, patients suffer navigating the complex referral process, which can have disastrous health effects if they don’t get the care they need. These factors point to a glaring gap in the system—where out of over 100 million specialist referrals issued annually in the US, only half are actually completed. Locata is tackling this problem head-on, saving administrative staff hours each week and ensuring that the referral process goes as smoothly as possible for patients and their providers.

Alejandro and Josh met at Stanford where they graduated with BS degrees in CS. Alejandro was a senior software engineer at Meta’s Reality Labs where he led development of several AI features for wearable products and prior to that conducted AI research at Stanford Medicine. Josh graduated with a masters in CS, specializing in AI, before working as a software engineer at Google, developing AI products that served over 1 billion users.

Within two weeks of building our product, we signed a major regional health center and are implementing our system to automate their entire referral workflow.

name: Opennote
tagline: The AI tutor that lives in your notes
long_description:
Opennote is building an AI tutor that lives in your notes, giving every student a truly personalized learning experience.

Most students struggle with scattered knowledge across different apps and tools that don't understand their learning style. Opennote changes that with an intelligent note-taking platform where your AI tutor knows your learning style, connects your existing knowledge bases and the web, and provides real-time feedback right where you're already working.
founders: Abhi Arya, Rishi Srihari, Vedant Vyas

name: SigmanticAI
tagline: Suite of AI Agents and Tools to Accelerate HDL Design
long_description:
SigmanticAI is building an AI-native hardware development assistant that automates the entire RTL design flow, from natural language to synthesizable HDL and testbenches, inside a seamless VSCode fork. Powered by fine-tuned Verilog LLMs, reinforcement learning, and real compiler feedback, SigmanticAI iteratively refines code until it compiles and passes synthesis, no matter how complex the design. It’s like the Cursor for HDL design. 

In addition to code generation, SigmanticAI can generate token-level annotations and onboarding documents to accelerate ramp-up for new engineers. With support for both cloud and on-prem deployment, it integrates with existing EDA tools to dramatically reduce debug time, improve collaboration, and accelerate hardware design across teams

name: F4
tagline: Automating compliance checks for engineering drawings
long_description:
Built by former Tesla & SpaceX engineers, F4 is a platform that helps you catch and fix drawing compliance issues instantly. F4 ensures design engineers never release noncompliant drawings—and suppliers never misinterpret them. We help hardware teams eliminate costly scrap, rework, and miscommunication at the root.

With a compliant drawing, F4 generates end-to-end drawing interpretations for standard definitions, inspection plan, and tolerance analysis application.

F4 automatically interprets all GD&T symbols, datums, and notes based on the correct standards - no more second-guessing or misreading intent. Everyone from design to manufacturing sees the same definition, keeping teams aligned and avoiding costly miscommunication.

F4 generates a complete inspection plan straight from the drawing, so quality teams know exactly what to measure, how, and where. This eliminates manual setup, reduces delays during first article inspection, and helps catch issues before they reach production.

F4 gives engineers everything they need from the drawing to set up a reliable tolerance analysis, including the critical stack-up paths,  applicable features, and rule exceptions. By making it easy to bridge engineering drawings to tolerance analysis, teams can catch potential fit or function issues early - before parts are fabricated and assembled.

name: PARES AI
tagline: Helping commercial real estate brokers find and close more deals.
long_description:
PARES is the single platform commercial real estate brokers need for their entire workflow, from chasing leads to closing deals and everything in between. 

With our platform, brokers can:

1) Automatically update real-time transaction data in our CRM

2) Create lists of target properties, skip-trace, and easily navigate outbound calls

3) Underwrite deals with our AI Underwriting Agent

4) Create OMs/BOVs in minutes with our AI Marketing Agent

Check us out at https://www.pares.ai/
founders: Kai Patragnoni, Zihao Wang, Daniel Weiner

name: Altur
tagline: AI agents for debt collection and sales
long_description: Altur replaces contact‑center reps with autonomous AI agents that collect debt and close sales.

name: Sira
tagline: AI HR manager for hourly teams
long_description:
Sira is the AI-powered platform for managing time tracking, scheduling, payroll, and HR — purpose-built for hourly teams.

Our intelligent agents handle the manual, time-consuming tasks for you — like calling workers to fill open shifts, detecting timesheet anomalies, and streamlining payroll processing.

With Sira, businesses stay organized, compliant, and focused on what really matters — while we take care of the team.

name: Eden
tagline: We turn customer and brand data into campaigns that convert
long_description:
Eden allows e-commerce brands to use customer data effectively when running campaigns. We help marketing teams understand their customers' stories by using data from their store, sales, support tickets, and marketing channels to turn hesitant browsers into customers who buy.

Alex and Jason met at TJHSST where they became nationally ranked debate partners and eventually coworkers at Datadog. Alex led operations at Phia, scaling to 100+ brand affiliate partners. Jason led retargeting ads at Reddit and previously sold an AI recruiting startup.

Existing marketing data sits in silos, underutilized. AI enables marketers to unlock a treasure trove of data to create more effective campaigns in a fraction of the time. We will make every marketing department data-driven.

name: Avelis Health
tagline: We audit medical claims for self-insured employers and health plans.
long_description:
𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐰𝐞 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬:
I (Angel) have had three knee surgeries since my mid-teens and was billed more than $250K for care that should have cost a fraction of that. Fighting those inflated charges was so painful that we set out to build a consumer-facing AI agent to do it for others. In less than five months, we helped sixty patients erase or reduce over $300K from their medical bills.

This inspired us to fix the problem farther upstream: stopping bad payments before the patient ever sees a bill. So we launched payment integrity, machine-learning models that audit every medical claim for self-insured employers and health plans in real time.

𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐛𝐥𝐞𝐦:
• Self-insured employers waste $60 B+ each year on claims that never should have been paid. Healthcare is the 2nd largest company expense after payroll.

• Manual audits are slow and partial: Reviewers focus only on high-dollar claims, letting millions more slip through unnoticed.

• Existing audit software is static: Decades-old rule engines can’t keep pace with evolving codes, contracts, or billing tactics.

• Incentives are misaligned: Third-party administrators are paid to process claims, not to police them, so accuracy checks are minimal.

𝐎𝐮𝐫 𝐒𝐨𝐥𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧:
Our models audit medical claims before and after payments have been issued. We catch nuanced billing, coding, and contract errors to save 3-7% on annual claims spend. We work with self-insured employers and health plans.

𝐀𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐔𝐬:
Angel Onuoha (CEO) and Ahmad Shehu (CTO) have worked together for 4 years. Before Avelis Health they built Zuvy, a Lagos-based fintech company that provided invoice factoring to small businesses. Zuvy was acquired by The BAS Group in 2025.

name: Idler
tagline: AI employees that handle the work, so people can do the magic.
founders: Ivan Chub, Nalu Concepcion, Tony Goss

name: Juxta
tagline: Building a GPS alternative 100x more powerful with no hardware needed.
long_description:
Juxta is creating the first Universal Positioning System (UPS) — a GPS alternative that can monitor movement anywhere on earth with no new hardware, minimal internet connection, and remote deployment. Using custom machine learning models and a first-of-its-kind synthetic fingerprinting technology, Juxta can make any indoor, outdoor, or underground space location-aware in minutes for a fraction of the cost of any other geospatial technology.

Juxta's UPS can be leveraged across industries — from securely tracking soldiers in combat zones to providing offline positioning for robots to offering asset tracking in warehouses and ports around the globe.

name: Floot
tagline: The easiest and most powerful way to build apps with AI.
long_description:
Floot lets non-coders & entrepreneurs build real web apps that actually work. We’re taking a new approach by building everything from the ground up for AI. Since June, 3000+ users have created over 4000 apps on Floot.

Existing AI app builders fall short of enabling non-coders to build real, serious apps. They often:
- Break down when building anything more than a prototype or toy app
- Have non-coders stuck with errors they don’t understand
- Require non-coders to handle multiple services designed for developers (e.g. for backend, database, hosting, etc)

The fundamental problem: these AI app builders just cobble together existing developer tools and slap AI on top, but these tools were designed for humans and not for AI.

The result? Non-coders get excited, start building, hit a wall, and then abandon their projects.

Floot is purpose-built for AI. Our secret sauce:
1) Instead of reusing a coding framework designed for humans, we created a specialized framework that dictates how AI should write code and how the code runs on our infrastructure. This allows us to enforce best practices, detect errors earlier, and give the best feedback to the AI. As a result, Floot can write better code and fix issues more effectively.
2) Floot has the entire tech stack built-in (backend, database, hosting, etc) so building and managing an app feels seamless, especially for non-coders. And because we control every layer of the stack, we can optimize each layer for AI-first coding.

Because of this, non-coders can get more done with less time and prompting. They can finally build serious apps that work, instead of getting stuck in frustrating error loops and then abandoning their projects.

We also built a highly scalable hosting system directly on AWS so Floot apps can handle real traffic and business demands. This means non-coders can build, deploy, and scale their apps on a single platform seamlessly.

Plus, Floot is really fun to use! Try building an app at floot.com

name: Humoniq
tagline: Voice AI agents for customer support in travel
long_description:
Humoniq is building voice AI agents to handle customer support for travel companies, such as airlines.

Our team is uniquely equipped to solve this challenge. We grew a travel management company, Flightfox (YC S12), to over $20M in annual sales while handling thousands of customer support requests.

Our mission now is to make customer support in travel the fastest and most helpful of any industry. We already have major travel companies signed and a rapidly growing deal pipeline.
founders: Tomasz Niedźwiecki, Todd Sullivan, Will Weber

name: Observee
tagline: Access 1000+ MCP integrations with a single API
long_description:
All AI Agents rely on external integrations to become truly useful. Our software provides any AI Agent developer with access to over 1,000 MCP integrations through a single API. 

In the last 6 months, MCP has become the official protocol for connecting AI agents to the outside world. Observee provides developers with Authentication, Observability and Security in one hosted MCP. 

As AI Agents increasingly take on more manual jobs, they will rely on Observee for underlying infrastructure.
founders: Rishabh Chanana, Rajmeet Singh Chandok, Chris Hailey

name: Risely AI
tagline: AI agents that automate administrative work across college campuses.
long_description:
Risely’s AI agents will form the new operating system for universities, improving retention, staff productivity, and efficiency. Our platform integrates directly into existing university systems (SIS, LMS, CRM), learns each institution’s unique workflows, and deploys specialized AI agents. This dramatically reduces the $735 billion universities spend annually on administrative labor, expands staff capacity without increasing headcount, and improves the student experience.

This hasn't been done before because university workflows require nuanced, autonomous judgment, exactly what agentic AI was designed to solve. Our team uniquely combines deep expertise in higher education, enterprise-scale AI, and regulated enterprise sales.

Sadia previously built Salesforce’s Education Cloud from scratch, creating the core Student Information System widely used across higher education. She deeply understands university operations and maintains trusted relationships with hundreds of higher-ed CIOs and Provosts.

Danial was one of DoorDash’s earliest engineers, where he architected and scaled complex systems from zero to billions of transactions, including their search, recommendation, and Voice AI platforms. He knows how to build robust AI solutions that reliably perform at enterprise scale. 

Shahryar was a GM at Airwallex, where he built the entire Americas business from 0 to 1 and drove 11x revenue growth.  He’s also a master closer, single-handedly securing over $17M in enterprise deals at NerdWallet.  He’s a relentless startup executor with deep expertise launching and scaling go-to-market machines in highly regulated industries.

We launched six weeks ago and are already at $8k MRR, growing 55% week-over-week -- one of the fastest ramps ever in higher ed. Universities urgently need solutions that expand labor capacity and efficiency, especially as they face unprecedented budget pressure and staffing shortages.

With unmatched buyer access, deep technical expertise, and rapid early traction, we are perfectly positioned to own this enormous market.
founders: Shahryar Abbasi, Danial Asif, Sadia Saifuddin

name: April
tagline: Voice AI Executive Assistant
long_description: April is a voice AI Executive assistant that manages your email and calendar, hands free. It’s built for busy individuals who need EAs but don’t have them.

name: Autosana
tagline: QA agent for mobile apps
long_description:
A cloud-based tool for mobile teams to run natural language end-to-end tests. Eradicates the need to write/maintain E2E tests and manual testing. Seamlessly integrates into your CI, supports both iOS and Android, and is framework-agnostic (React Native, Flutter, Swift, etc).

No code, no setup, just catching bugs before users do.

name: Socratix AI
tagline: AI coworkers for fraud and risk teams.
long_description:
Socratix builds AI coworkers for fraud and risk teams so that humans don't have to spend their days drowning in alerts and spreadsheets.

Today, fraud and risk teams at fintechs and banks are overwhelmed. Analysts jump between tools, manually stitch together context, and make judgment calls under pressure, often for hundreds of alerts a week. Too much of their work is slow, repetitive, and error-prone. We're here to change that. 

Socratix gives fraud and risk teams AI coworkers that investigate alerts in real time, replacing manual reviews with fast, explainable decisions. Socratix agents plug into existing workflows and reason across signals just like human analysts to help teams reduce fraud losses, minimize false positives, and scale operations without scaling headcount.

We've seen this problem firsthand. At DoorDash, Riya helped save $30M+ a year by building smarter fraud detection and investigation tooling, and at Unit21, she built products for analysts that made them 3X faster. We're able to build and sell enterprise-grade software. At Cruise, Satya built scalable AI systems powering petabyte-scale data, and at LinkedIn, he built enterprise products from 0 to 1 generating $50M+ in incremental revenue. Now, the two of us are teaming up to eliminate the manual toil in fraud and risk.

We're obsessed with fraud, LLMs, real-world automation, and the messy edge cases traditional ML has trouble handling. We believe that every fraud analyst should have an AI coworker - and the future of fraud will involve combining human-level reasoning with machine-speed execution.

name: mcp-use
tagline: Open-source dev tools and infrastructure for MCP.
long_description:
mcp-use provides open-source dev tools and infrastructure for MCP to help dev teams quickly build and deploy custom AI agents with MCP servers. 
Our library has over 100,000 downloads and 4,000 stars, and is used by hundreds of engineers at big enterprises.
We provide a hosted and self-hosted platform that manages auth, access control, and multi-user environments for secure MCP agents deployment at scale.

name: Motives
tagline: Qualitative consumer research run by AI
long_description: Motives is a team of AI agents that runs qualitative research projects for consumer brands: moderating and analyzing video interviews to help brands understand consumer preferences and test new ideas, in hours instead of weeks.

name: Omnara
tagline: The command center for your AI agents
long_description:
As AI agents handle longer, more complex tasks, human oversight becomes critical. Omnara provides the human-in-the-loop infrastructure to make autonomous agents reliable.

Our platform lets users and teams manage AI agents through a unified dashboard. When agents face uncertainty, hit roadblocks, or need permissions that require human judgment, they pause and request guidance, ensuring workflows stay on track. Any agent can integrate, e.g. Claude Code, n8n workflows, or custom builds.

name: Finto

long_description: Finto builds an AI platform that automates the invoice-to-pay process for enterprises operating on ERP Systems. Cutting out 80% of the accountants daily work in invoice recording, account coding and  invoice approvals.

name: Novaflow
tagline: The AI data analyst for biology labs
long_description:
Novaflow is the AI data analyst for biology labs. 
--
Bioinformatics data analysis is a time-consuming and expensive process for scientists. With Novaflow, life scientists can upload experimental data, ask questions in plain English, and get instant, publication-ready plots, giving them results in minutes instead of months.

name: Phases

founders: James Wall, Anton Zaliznyi, Jonathan van Wersch

name: Perseus Defense
tagline: Guided micro-missiles for Counter-UAS.
long_description:
Perseus Defense is building a mass-manufactured Counter UAS solution for the Department of Defense and Department of Homeland Security. Current solutions are one-to-one, too dangerous for use on U.S. soil, and orders of magntiude more expensive than the threats they defeat. Our micro-guided missile system is man-portable, multi-domain capable, and has both forward-deployed and low-collateral defeat variants. It senses, engages, and eliminates threats with drastically reduced cost per engagement. 

Solving this critical national security problem requires understanding complex DoD needs along with actual rocket science including aerodynamics, guidance, navigation, control, and much more. Jason and Steve met at Penn State while they pursued a PhD and MS in aerospace engineering, respectively. Their past experiences designing space helicopters for NASA, making Boeing airliners land autonomously, controlling swarms of unmanned autonomous systems, teaching aerospace engineering at Stanford, winning multiple ONR and DOE engineering competitions, and founding an international drone competition makes them the perfect team to create transformative solutions protecting our service members. 

"If you build this, it will be mandatory equipment for every truck, boat, and convoy in the U.S. Military. We're talking thousands of units." - Former DoD Procurement Officer

The White House just released Executive Order, "Unleashing American Drone Dominance" which adds billions of dollars, government support, and streamlined regulations to enable the development of our product. 

Traction: 
A UAS prototype was designed and built in one week and a prototype of the guided missile was prototyped in four days. Following the Stanford Hacking for Defense process that Perseus Defense adviser and former Army Ranger Dr. Jeff Decker wrote the book on, Jason and Steve used 60 end-user interviews across the DoD and DHS to shape the product to something of critical need to both boots on the ground and DoD purchasers. Perseus has already been invited to a Phase-II in-person pitch of their solution to government end-users, signaling progress towards contract opportunities.

name: Summon
tagline: Open-Source Postman for MCP servers
long_description:
Summon is the complete end-to-end MCP platform. We're building the pipes connecting context to client applications for the agent economy. 

Summon transforms MCP development from a fragmented, manual process into an AI-first, collaborative workflow. We build MCP servers from OpenAPI specs using our AI agent, provide debugging playgrounds, run continuous evaluations against different LLMs, and offer enterprise hosting with observability. This creates a complete virtuous loop where AI builds, maintains, and improves MCP integrations, accelerating time-to-market, reducing bugs, and aligning developers, QA, and product teams.

With MCP gaining adoption across ChatGPT, Claude, and Microsoft Copilot, companies need agent-accessible APIs to remain competitive.

name: Solva

We've spent the last decade battling legacy systems and dogma across highly regulated sectors of the financial industry. Between the three of us we have experience from scaling Europe’s fastest-growing InsurTech and founding a licensed bank (EBA CRD CI).

name: Riff
tagline: Cursor for music production
long_description:
Riff is a super powered music editor where experienced producers can be dramatically more productive and hobbyists can delight in music without needing technical chops.

As we continue to build, we see Riff turning into an entirely new paradigm for creating music.

name: Mohi
tagline: Analyze and understand complex agent workflows with clarity.
long_description:
We help people understand their agent workflows and where they went wrong.

We met early on at MIT and built a bunch of projects together for fun. Of course when the AI wave took over, we were excited about agents. We made our own agents, and we always found it annoying figuring out if they consistently worked or not.

We believe that it should be easy to know what your agents are doing and why, no matter the use case or the tech stack. So that's exactly what we're helping companies achieve; we started building a few weeks ago and are working with our design partner to get deep observability and insights into their agent executions.

The future is autonomous; AI agents will be everywhere. Mohi can make sure that we humans know what these agents are doing.

name: Albacore Inc.

name: VibeFlow
tagline: Prompt to full stack app with visual workflows
long_description: VibeFlow generates full-stack web apps from prompts with n8n-style visual workflows for the backend. name: Nozomio

try nia at trynia .ai <3

Comena streamlines order and quote entry, from inbox to ERP, freeing up sales teams to focus on high-value activities and proactive selling.

name: Mimos
tagline: Helping regulated firms show up in AI search.
long_description:
Mimos is an Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) platform designed for regulated experts, starting with Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs). 

We help highly-regulated companies get discovered and trusted on AI platforms like ChatGPT and Gemini, driving qualified inbound while staying compliant.

===

Rohit & Mike have been working together on various technical project since middle school (13 years!) - and Mimos came about as one of those projects.

name: Channel3
tagline: Database of every product on the internet
long_description:
Channel3 is building a database of every product on the internet.

Google and OpenAI maintain vast product graphs, but keep that valuable data to themselves. Channel3 gives every developer access, opening a world of possibility for new shopping experiences across any vertical. For instance, developers could build AI fashion stylists or give their agents shopping capabilities.

We don’t just collect product data; we actually understand it. With the latest image classification and reasoning models, we can match products across merchants—even when listings and images differ—recognize variants, and surface the perfect matches for every search. As we grow, we’ll capture unique insights into what users want, click, and buy.

As AI models get smarter and cheaper, our flywheel accelerates: our catalog will improve, and it will be even easier for developers and vibe-coders to build on our infrastructure. To further incentivize building on Channel3, we provide built-in monetization; developers earn commissions on sales they drive.

Alex discovered this need while building an AI tutor that could recommend products and earn affiliate revenue. When no solution existed, he persuaded his smartest friend from Duke and former co-founder George to leave Palantir and build Channel3 together.

name: Epicenter
tagline: A database for your mind, built on plain text.
long_description:
Epicenter is an ecosystem of open-source, local-first apps. We store all your work—notes, transcripts, chat histories—in a single folder of plain text and SQLite. Every tool we build shares this memory: your text editor, personal assistant, etc.. It's open, tweakable, and yours. Grep it, open it in Obsidian, host it wherever you like. The choice is yours.

Our vision is to build a personal workspace where you own your data, choose your models, and replace siloed apps with open, interoperable alternatives. All while preserving authenticity and being free and open source. ❤️

https://github.com/epicenter-so/epicenter

name: Candytrail
tagline: AI Agents that run your sales funnel and train your reps
long_description:
Candytrail uses AI Agents to run your sales funnel on autopilot and train your reps.

• AI Lead Discovery: Web-crawling agents crawl your ideal market to surface high-intent leads and deliver personalized outreach. You receive a curated list of buyers plus a ready-to-send, personalized email crafted to maximize replies.

• Conversation Intelligence: Every call is automatically recorded, transcribed, and scored. Candytrail’s pattern-engine highlights the phrases, objection-handling tactics, and talk-time ratios that correlate with closed deals.

• Auto-Coaching at Scale: Reps get real-time tips on winning conversation patterns, and managers can drop timestamped feedback that lands straight on each rep’s phone—delivering “ride-along” insights after every single call.

We’re starting with Med Spas, but support any sales organization from B2B SaaS to cash-pay clinics.

long_description:
The problem we solve: 56% of dealership leads arrive after business hours, and most dealers lose these potential customers to competitors who happen to be available 24/7. Missing after-hours calls alone costs the average dealership $1M annually in lost revenue.

We built Flai to fix this - AI assistants that answer dealership calls 24/7, scheduling test drives, oil changes, or running outbound recall campaigns so no opportunity slips away.

Our founding team has built voice AI products at HappyRobot, scaled infrastructure at Uber for millions of users, and applied data science at Netflix to solve operational challenges.

We're not just answering phones, we're helping dealerships win in an AI-first world where availability determine who gets the sale.

name: Parachute
tagline: Evaluate, Deploy, and Monitor Clinical AI
long_description: Parachute helps hospitals adopt AI safely and at scale. We vet AI tools that fill clinical gaps, run state-of-the-art evaluations, monitor every model for drift and compliance, and lock every decision in an immutable audit trail.

name: BootLoop
tagline: Firmware in minutes, not months - rigorously tested on real hardware
long_description: BootLoop is building the first AI agent to write and test firmware on real hardware. Existing AI coding assistants fail completely with embedded systems, but our agent ingests datasheets, schematics, and other design files to write firmware in your style and automatically test it on your hardware.

name: Riverbank
tagline: AI Agents for Penetration Testing
long_description: Riverbank is creating the first AI native internal security team, starting with the $3B pentesting market. We blend AI agents with experienced human operators and red teamers to find what traditional vulnerability scanners miss to create more secure, resilient cyber postures.

name: Louiza Labs
tagline: Simulated human biology and synthetic medical datasets.
long_description:
Louiza Labs accurately simulates human biology so medical technology (devices, robots, etc) can be trained and tested without real patients or hard to access real-world medical data.

Our physics-driven AI engine creates hyper-accurate, multi-organ human models with unprecedented speed and fidelity.

Instead of spending millions on data for clinical trials, cadaver labs, or risky human testing—use Louiza to:
1. Test devices on digital twins—faster FDA, no animal trials.
2. Generate rare, high-fidelity edge-case datasets.
3. Train AI for combat, triage, and robotic procedures in extreme conditions.
4. Simulate stressed anatomy (e.g., Bruno Fernandes under fatigue, fighter pilots under G-force).

Bonus: Our anatomically accurate models are indistinguishable from real humans and can be “imaged” (e.g., X-ray, ultrasound) for use in ML pipelines.

name: AgentHub
tagline: The simulation and evaluation engine for AI agents
long_description:
AgentHub helps you catch and fix errors in your AI agents - before your users ever see them.

Simulate real-world scenarios in curated RL environments for your agents - trace, evaluate, and improve agent behavior at scale. Generate large annotated datasets and experiment with different prompts, models, and configurations - all in one place - with clear visualizations of what’s working (and what’s not).

Built by a former tech lead from Apple’s Foundation Model Eval team and a product engineer from MIT with experience working on agents at startups, AgentHub makes it easy to integrate your use case and start improving your agents quickly.

Our streamlined onboarding process lets you get your agent eval environment up and running fast—no heavy lifting on your end.

Close the feedback loop and build better agents, faster - with confidence.

name: Slashy
tagline: ChatGPT with Hands
long_description:
Slashy is a general agent that connects to your G-Suite, Slack, Notion, Linear, and more to take in your personal context and perform actions. 

Consider it an agentic Glean that allows knowledge workers to save 2-3 hours a day of busy work.

name: Lemma

We’re building Lemma because we’ve been there.

We’ve worked in professional services and lived the pain — buried in work that doesn’t move the needle. Aggregating numbers from back surveys. Hunting for that one number buried in a mountain of files. Pulling quotes from hours of expert calls. Drafting version 10 of the interview guide. Rebuilding the same CDD survey from scratch. Lemma builds AI teammates tailored to the way you actually work — built by people who’ve done the work. Our agents plug into your tools, learn your processes, and handle the grunt work behind the scenes — so you can focus on insights, strategy, and moving fast.

Kestroll eliminates the laborious labeling process and provides easy content access for the entire organization, without the clunky interfaces and long learning curves of traditional MAMs.

The days of filtering through someone else's tags are past. With Kestroll, anyone in the organization can search in everyday language, based on visual cues, abstract concepts, creative intent, and more, without the burden of manual labeling.

name: DeepGrove

name: Stockline
tagline: AI-native ERP for food wholesalers

Stockline is reshaping ERPs to bring innovation to a $990B+ industry left behind by the tech revolution: the food supply chain.

Food wholesalers still rely on software from the 90s. One symptom among many: they waste hours retyping orders and invoices that arrive through scattered channels like WhatsApp, SMS, and email into their ERPs. Manual admin work takes over. Headcount grows just to handle repetitive tasks.
This leads to mistakes, tight margins, and food waste.

Stockline replaces outdated ERPs with AI at its core. The game-changer? No more manual data entry. Our AI pulls orders from every channel and feeds them directly into one unified system.

Admin disappears. Wholesalers get to focus on what really matters: their products and their customers.

Frizzle eliminates the most time-consuming part of teachers’ workflows, and is the most valuable piece of software ever for teachers. Our platform helps educators automate repetitive tasks like grading and feedback, so they can focus on what matters most - teaching. 

Two principles guide our work. First, build tools teachers actually trust and enjoy using. Second, design products that are simple, fast, and seamlessly fit into the classroom.

name: Janet AI
tagline: The AI-Native Ticket Triage and Management Layer for Jira
long_description:
Big companies are drowning in Jira tickets. They get thousands of reported issues every month—most never seen by anyone with full context. Related issues are filed under different teams. De-duping is tedious. Critical insights get lost in comment threads. Teams spend hundreds of hours just figuring out what’s important—before they can even start fixing it.

Janet AI is the AI-native ticket triage and management layer for Jira.

Janet AI watches every incoming ticket and compares it to everything that’s come before. It builds a knowledge graph across projects: which tickets are duplicates, which share the same root cause, and which roll up into the same component failure. It automatically surfaces related tickets, flags prior fixes, and identifies what matters most—across all projects and teams.

This transforms how organizations handle tickets at scale:
• Customer support can immediately check if engineering is already working on a reported issue, reducing back-and-forth and surfacing statuses and fixes faster.
• Ticket routing becomes smarter—Janet shows which individuals or teams are already tackling related issues.
• Engineering teams get cross-project visibility—seeing how other teams are solving similar problems and avoiding redundant work.
• No more context lost in silos—when 20 related tickets each contain a piece of the puzzle, Janet AI connects the dots. You can ask Janet to explore related issues and extract the insights you’d otherwise miss.

Several multi‑billion‑dollar enterprises are already in talks with Janet AI to reduce the manual work involved in managing tickets at scale.

Interested? Visit tryjanet.ai to book a demo, get started, or watch short videos showing how Janet AI works across each use case.

name: Halluminate
tagline: Data and environments to train computer use AI
long_description:
We help foundation model labs and enterprises train computer use AI agents with data and sandboxes.

A knowledge worker spends 90% of their day on a computer. A productive AI agent must similarly learn how to use our computers, browsers, and software to deliver real world value. 

Today, browser and computer use AI is inaccurate, slow, and expensive. Model labs and enterprises who want to improve these agents are bottlenecked by two resources: 

1) High quality datasets for benchmarking and evaluations
2) Realistic sandbox environments for safe and accurate testing/training (ex. a simulated version of Salesforce) 

Halluminate offers a suite of products and services to address both these issues. 

Our evaluation service combines proprietary datasets with high quality annotations to help our customers identify and prioritize the biggest failure modes of their computer- and browser- use AI. 

Our platform provides a catalog of fully managed sandboxes, empowering our customers to safely and accurately test/train at scale, resulting in improved performance. 

Our customers see
- Improved browser- and computer-use agent performance
- New and emergent frontier agent capabilities
- Data driven prioritization leading to exponentially faster development speed
- Increased revenue/sales via marketing from public benchmarks

Our paying customers already include leading computer use model labs and the two largest browser agent companies in the space. 

Wyatt and Jerry are friends that met their first week of school studying CS at Cornell University. They’ve been working and studying together for 7+ years.

name: MorphoAI

long_description:
We're building an AI powered platform for engineers that are building new robots and machines.

Ayna and Andy, the co-founders, met during their time at Harvard and started this in 2024 as their programs were wrapping up. We're bringing in our deep knowledge of modifying equipment and integrating it into factories keenly understanding what makes hardware hard.

name: Scalar Field

We’re building an AI-powered Bloomberg Terminal using Financial Agents.

I used to be a trader at Tower Research and Goldman Sachs, and I’m building Scalar Field with my co-founder Ramakant, who led engineering teams at Microsoft.

We’ve both spent our careers at the intersection of finance and technology — and we’re using that experience to reimagine how markets are analyzed and traded.

Scalar Field is built around a simple idea: most people log into a terminal because, consciously or subconsciously, they’re trying to validate a hypothesis.

But today’s terminals don’t help with that. They’re dashboards — not thinking tools.

So we built Scalar Field to change that: a platform where users can test any market hypothesis instantly using intelligent agents.

You can spin up agents that react to market events, run backtests across data from multiple asset classes, and even trigger trades when specific conditions are met — all in one place.

name: Besimple AI
tagline: AI powered data annotation
long_description:
Spin up your own data annotation platform in 60 seconds!

High-quality, human-reviewed data is essential for improving AI models.  Yet, many teams still use outdated tools or spreadsheets that aren’t built for complex data from LLMs and AI agents. This slows down iteration, drives up costs, and makes model performance unpredictable in real-world use.

With Besimple, you can generate your own platform for annotating AI evaluation and training data instantly.  Simply paste or stream any type of raw data—text, chat, audio, video, or LLM outputs—and we'll instantly generate a tailored annotation interface, clear guidelines, and an automated human-in-the-loop workflow.  Our AI Judges quickly learn from human annotations, take over labeling for easy cases, and evaluate live production data, letting your team focus only on critical edge cases.

Key differentiators
1. Instant custom UI - Automatically generate tailored annotation interfaces just by uploading your data. Adjust easily whenever data or needs change.
2. Tailored guidelines – Import any existing guidelines or we will draft new ones aligned with your business goals, ready for annotation
3. AI Judges for real-time evaluation – AI-powered judges continuously improve by learning human preferences, automatically labeling data and flagging tough cases for expert review.
4. Enterprise-grade deployment – On-prem optional install, and robust user management for internal SMEs, external vendors, or Besimple’s vetted annotators.
5. Lightning-Fast Setup: No code, no plugins—just drop in your data, set guidelines, and you’re good to go.

Today we power evaluation and training pipelines for leading AI companies in customer support, search, education, and more.  For example, the leading AI grading company Edexia uses besimple to annotate hundreds of decisions and improve their evals.

Besimple is built by a team that has done this before. Yi Zhong and Bill Wang built the annotation platform for Meta’s Llama models, significantly improving quality of data and shortening model development cycle.

Reach out!

If you’re building an AI product and struggle with good eval or training data —or if you have models in prod with no idea why they fail—let’s talk. We’ll show you how to launch a custom annotation flow in a minute, bootstrap an AI Judge in an afternoon, and start shipping better models tomorrow.

name: Opusense AI

Opusense AI automates field report writing for construction field inspectors. Instead of typing up notes at the end of the day, inspectors can now walk a site, speak observations aloud, snap photos, and let our AI assistant generate a detailed, organized report on-site and in real time.

Combined, the founding team has over 15 years in the construction industry. Writing up these field reports used to take up at least 20% of the week. With Opusense, we cut that time by 5x. name: Tinfoil
tagline: Tinfoil makes your AI workflows secure, verifiable, and private.
long_description:
Tinfoil makes it easy to make your AI workloads provably private, without changing your code. You get the privacy of on-prem deployments, while running on the cloud.

We’ve built a full-stack platform on top of the latest NVIDIA GPUs offering confidential computing capabilities, meaning that you don’t have to tradeoff performance for privacy. 

Under the hood, we integrate a suite of recent advances in secure hardware technologies, in particular NVIDIA’s confidential compute mode available on Hopper and Blackwell. When combined with Tinfoil’s software stack, companies can prove their security claims rather than relying on unenforceable statements like "trust us, we don’t log your queries.” Tinfoil guarantees that all data always stays private and cannot be accessed by anyone other than the end user — not even by Tinfoil or the cloud provider it’s processed on. 

The founding team combines deep academic and industry experience in security and internet protocols. Tanya was previously a systems engineer at Cloudflare, where she built Internet security protocols used by billions, and contributed to the Workers AI platform. Jules and Sacha recently completed their PhDs at MIT where they worked on secure hardware and privacy-preserving technologies. Jules has also worked at NVIDIA on their confidential computing team. Nate has deep infrastructure experience, starting in high school when he built a mini-CDN that got him an internship at Cloudflare. Tinfoil was born from our personal frustration with the false choice between access to powerful AI and data privacy.

As AI becomes tightly integrated into our lives and business workflows, it will touch an ever increasing amount of sensitive personal and proprietary data. Right now, the only solutions are DPAs, band-aids like PII redaction, or the nuclear option of running everything on-prem. These solutions are not scalable.  By making it easy to deploy provable privacy, Tinfoil promises to unlock significantly deeper AI adoption and integrations, just as TLS on the Internet enabled e-commerce to flourish by securing credit cards on the network.

If OpenAI is creating “God in a box”, we are putting God in a blackbox, so Satan can’t spy.
founders: Tanya Verma, Jules Drean, Nate Sales, Sacha Servan-Schreiber

Better Auth is a comprehensive authentication framework for TypeScript that lets you implement everything from simple auth flows to enterprise-grade systems directly on your own database, embedded in your backend. name: Kestral
tagline: AI Agents that prioritize the highest impact work across Sales and R&D
long_description:
Kestral makes it clear what your customers want most, prioritizes those tasks for highest leverage, and closes the loop with those customers.

We (Brian and Bernard) have been close friends since university, and most recently worked together at Asana, leading AI and Authorization efforts. There we realized AI can completely disrupt the $50B Work Management Market, but it required a fresh start.

What work we even choose to manage in the first place is critical, and the most important insights from customers are silo-ed in sales/CS while R&D gives their best shot at roadmaps meant to deliver impact. Significant requests sit in a backlog, duplicate asks flood the system, months wasted on "strategic investments". We want to bridge this gap.

This message is resonating with heads of sales, heads of product, CEOs, as well as individuals, all trying to make sure the most important things get done, with less wasted effort and more revenue/retention.

Kestral works by automatically take in customer data like sales call transcripts & feature request messages and a team of agents:
1. analyze them for actionable takeaways, deal blockers, and nice to haves
2. consolidate them and manage all the asks with citations
3. prioritize them by impact and frequency to cut through the noise so you can see the biggest opportunities clearly
4. connect them to your existing strategic roadmap so when the work gets done, we can automatically follow back up with your customers and win them over

This is just step one of our mission to revolutionize how work gets done -- starting with what we choose to work on, and hope you follow us along for the ride!

name: Attune
tagline: Faster builds, zero effort.
long_description:
Attune makes blazingly fast build tools that require zero migration effort.

As AI enables developers to write code faster than ever, slow builds are increasingly becoming the bottleneck in development velocity. Developers regularly lose hours of productivity every day waiting for their builds. Imagine being able to write code in 1 minute, but needing to wait 30 minutes to compile, deploy, and test it.

Existing solutions either require painful migrations to new tools (e.g. Bazel) or rely on just using bigger servers to run your builds. Instead, we do native, first-class integrations into compilers and build systems.

With Attune, you don't need to integrate a new tool. Just make a one-line change from `cargo build` to `hurry cargo build` for 20x faster builds.

Eliza (ex-Google) and Xin worked together for 3 years at FOSSA, where Eliza was Head of Engineering and Xin was Head of Product. Eliza brings a decade of programming languages and build systems expertise, while Xin brings a decade of experience building developer tools products, most recently as VP of Product at Teleport (S15). Having experienced the pain of slow builds firsthand across hundreds of production codebases, we're building the solution we've always wanted.

name: PgDog
tagline: Scaling engine for PostgreSQL
long_description:
PgDog is an application for sharding PostgreSQL. It understands SQL and can distribute queries automatically between databases. It's built for managed databases, like AWS RDS, and doesn't require any changes to application code or schema.

In addition to sharding, PgDog is a load balancer and pooler, so it can act as a replacement for PgBouncer, RDS Proxy, and other Postgres scaling products. It brings the simplicity and performance of HTTP load balancing to the database.

Built from the experience of sharding Postgres at Instacart during peak growth in 2020, PgDog is the answer to the old question: does Postgres scale? It does now.

name: Bluejay

Customers frequently use different identifiers for items, different units, and close but not quite the same descriptors. Employees aren't just copy-pasting (or manually typing) PDF data into an ERP, they have to validate every item in the ERP.

With Percival, businesses can just email customer POs and other requests to a dedicated @percivaltech.com email address. Once the request is handled, Percival responds to the email with the result: whether that's an order number in the ERP or a list of prices.

name: Caucus

The rapidly growing creator economy ($250B+) consists of millions of solo entrepreneurs still managing complex business finances with spreadsheets and a patchwork of disconnected tools. name: Claim Health

long_description:
Post-acute agencies lose up to 15% of revenue each year to denials, non-compliant documentation, and delayed payments. Most treat it as a cost of doing business. Instead of waiting weeks for rejections and appealing claims one by one, Claim Health flags issues in real-time and automates claim corrections and appeals—before revenue is lost.

While working with healthcare providers, we found most denials stem from small, preventable documentation errors. As payor requirements grow increasingly complex and fragmented, billing has become a manual, error-prone process. Claim Health closes the loop between documentation and billing outcomes—using AI to detect issues, automate workflows, and recover thousands in missed revenue each week.

Kevin and JJ bring nearly a decade of experience building and scaling healthtech companies. At Dandy, JJ was a founding engineer and Kevin was the first GTM hire; together they helped grow the business from 0 to $150M+ ARR. At Perry (now Jolly), JJ led engineering and Kevin was Head of Sales, driving the company through a $16.5M Series A led by Tesla’s former CFO.

In under three weeks since incorporation, we've launched with three agencies and are in early discussions with large U.S. health systems.

Post-acute care is a $400B market with over $20B in annual revenue leakage due to broken billing workflows. Claim Health is fixing that—starting with denials, and expanding into the full revenue cycle stack.
